description.zh:
结束时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
description.en:
The end time.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh:
事件类型。
>关于事件类型的取值，请参见[DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~)。
description.en:
The event type.

> You can call the [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~) operation to query the types of system events.
The ID of the application group.

description.zh:
事件级别，取值：

- CRITICAL：严重
- WARN：警告
- INFO：信息
description.en:
The level of the event. Valid values:

- CRITICAL

- WARN

- INFO

description.zh:
事件名称。
>关于事件名称的取值，请参见[DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~)。
description.en:
The event name.

> You can call the [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~) operation to query the names of system events.

description.zh:
产品的名称缩写。
>关于产品名称缩写的取值，请参见[DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~)。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the service name.

> You can call the [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~) operation to query the abbreviations of service names.

description.zh:
搜索事件内容包含的关键字。取值：

- 如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括a和b，可以搜索`a and b`。

- 如果您待搜索事件的内容中包括a或b，可以搜索`a or b`。
description.en:
The keywords that are used to search for the system event. Valid values:

- If you want to search for the system event whose content contains a and b, set the value to `a and b`.

- If you want to search for the system event whose content contains a or b, set the value to `a or b`.

description.zh:
开始时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
description.en:
The start time.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh:
事件状态。

>关于事件状态的取值，请参见[DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~)。
description.en:
The event status.

> You can call the [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~) operation to query the status of system events.

title.zh: 查询系统事件的时段数量分布图（柱状图）

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-system-event-histogram --product OSS --event-type Exception --name BucketIngressBandwidth --level CRITICAL --status normal --group-id 12345 --search-keywords cms --start-time 1552209685596 --end-time 1552220485596 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeSystemEventHistogram --region cn-hangzhou --Status normal --EndTime 1552220485596 --EventType Exception --StartTime 1552209685596 --Product OSS --Level CRITICAL --SearchKeywords cms --Name BucketIngressBandwidth --GroupId 12345
